why_trail.why: Context loaded; handoff complete. Proceeding to the discovery layer under TDD.
Discovery layer green: corpus = tracked *.py minus .agent-work/. Hermetic synthetic-repo tests plus one rule-asserting integration test; no pinned count.

CLI is one argparse entrypoint over six stage subcommands; --root defaults to this repo and resolves the artifact/map dirs at parse time so callers cannot drift. Stage imports are deferred into handlers so parsing does not pay for the extractor. 7 CLI tests green and discover exits 0 against this repo.

astx.py ported verbatim to extract.py: the two AST passes, the resolver and every visitor are unchanged, so D1/D2/D3 survive for the gates that own them. Only the edges moved -- the hardcoded f1Brainz ROOT is now a run() parameter, INDEX_DIRS and slice_manifest.json are both replaced by discover_corpus, and the report lost its timing fields. 108 modules indexed, 85321 statements, 0 failures over this repo.

supplement.py ported unimproved -- same eight gap ids, same fields, same walk; g3 deletes this stage by folding the gaps into the statement schema, so improving it now would be work thrown away. Root and file list come from run(root) and discover_corpus; the report lost its timings. 3482 entities over 109 modules, 0 failures.

render_map.py ported to render.py with its import-time store loading moved into load_stores(), so importing the module costs nothing and a second run against a different root is possible at all. The top index is titled from the git common dir's parent, not the directory name, because a worktree directory is named for the branch. build wires extract -> supplement -> render and exits 0: 3600 pages, 3489 entities, alias_missing 0 over this repo. Two hermetic tests now cover the wiring -- one that every stage produces its artifact, one that scratch never reaches the page tree -- without pinning page content g2/g3 will change.

checks.py and checks2.py folded into one module and wired to the check subcommand, print-only and returning 0 -- they assert nothing, so g1 still has its rewrite to do. The prototype's fourth section is dropped and the docstring says why: it spot-checked one hardcoded file of another repo, and the real rule it demonstrated (every top-level def gets a page) belongs in g1 as a corpus-wide check, not as one file's probe.

TWO .gitignore entries per the addendum's ruling, not the item's three -- no gate produces a position cache, so that line would be the stale rule this plan exists to remove. Bundling resolved as (b): NON_INSTALLABLE_PACKAGES declares code_map unbundlable because the install destination is flat and flattening strips the package its relative imports resolve against; scripts/hooks/ stays flattenable because its modules import nothing from each other. Four guard tests hold every scripts/ subdirectory to one declaration or the other, and the declaration is falsifiable -- emptying it turned 3 of the 4 red.

The exclusion is load-bearing and the test that guards it can fail. Removing it turned 4 tests red, not the 3 predicted -- both CLI tests catch the leak as well as the two discovery tests -- and the mutation was confirmed applied by git diff before the run, so the red is the exclusion's absence and not a broken import. Restoring it returned a clean git status and 5 passed on -k discovery, 14 passed on the whole file.

Gate g0 closes green. Full suite 1706 passed / 2 skipped / 0 failed against a 1688/2/0 baseline -- 18 tests up, nothing red. The one failure in the first run was tests/test_crew_launcher.py asserting PYTHONIOENCODING=='utf-8' while run_crew.py:271 deliberately setdefault-preserves an ambient value; this crew's shell exports utf-8:surrogateescape. Proved by removing the var (74 passed) and restoring it (1 failed). Not this gate's code and filed as a triage candidate. Wiring: 76 new symbols, 178 call sites outside their own definition and outside any self-test, resolved through imports with the AST because a bare-name grep is meaningless here (run/main/_check are defined in dozens of scripts and matched 4535 times). 75 of 76 are wired into production code; NON_INSTALLABLE_PACKAGES has zero non-test consumers, which is the stop condition -- reported for the Commander's confirmation rather than ruled by me, because a non-installable package's correct runtime behavior is to do nothing, so the guard tests are its enforcement point by design. Corpus re-derives to 112 files. The three .gitignore run-report entries were already landed at 5aa4170 and were verified against the ruling, not redone.
